copy.tagline: 自动生成新员工入职流程与任务清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责新员工入职安排，想自动化首周日程和任务分配。
copy.tagline_en: Automate new employee onboarding tasks and schedules
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage employee onboarding and want to automate first-week tasks.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按模板生成新员工入职单页,包含欢迎区(姓名、入职日、团队)、首周5天日程、经理与Buddy卡片、学习路径、设备清单、完成标准。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建新员工入职页,或提到“首周日程”、“buddy”、“设备清单”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一份新员工入职页,包含首周日程和 Buddy 卡片。
say.note: Claude 将按模板生成单页布局。

say.text: 给新人生成入职模板,要有学习路径和设备清单。
创建入职页,加上完成标准区。
say.note: Claude 会补充 outcomes 区。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the template to produce an onboarding page: hero (name, start date, team), 5-day schedule, manager/buddy cards, learning track, equipment checklist, and outcome criteria. Output is structured.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to create an employee onboarding page or mention keywords like 'first-week schedule', 'buddy', 'equipment checklist'.

say_en.text: Create an onboarding page with first-week schedule and buddy cards.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the single-page layout.

say_en.text: Generate an onboarding template with learning track and equipment checklist.
Build an onboarding page and add a completion criteria section.
